_comment: KUT climate overlay. UNVERIFIED — do not present these values as confirmed design data. The record is LABELLED Kampala and carries the ENTEBBE station (HUEN / WMO 636800): latitude 0.042, longitude 32.444 and elevation 1155 m are Entebbe International Airport, roughly 35 km south of the site and about 40 m lower. Using the nearest long-record station as a proxy is normal practice, but it is stated here rather than hidden, because the elevation feeds the air-density correction and the site sits higher than the station. The values are an estimate pending confirmation by the engineer of record against ASHRAE 2021, and that confirmation is a row on the standards reconciliation schedule (BEP 4.1.3) — it is not closed. Replace both the values and this note when it is.

sites.label: Kampala (Entebbe station HUEN/636800 as proxy)

windSource.ashraeEdition: 2025 ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals - Chapter 14 Climatic Design Information
windSource.verify: Taken from the climate.onebuilding.org redistribution, not the printed handbook: the TMYx 2009-2023 .stat 'MCWS/PCWD to 99.6% DB' and 'MCWS/PCWD to 0.4% DB' columns were read and both equal the annual heating / cooling design-day wind speeds in the .ddy of the same download. Confirm against the licensed ASHRAE 2025 Fundamentals Ch. 14 table for this WMO station.
windSource.note: Entebbe Intl AP (HUEN, WMO 637050) used as the proxy for Kampala, as the site's lat/lon/elevation already are. Design-condition grade B, period 2000-2023. Note: WMO 636800 (cited in this site's temperature source) is onebuilding.org's Kampala station, not Entebbe.

sites.source: UNVERIFIED ESTIMATE. Entebbe station geometry with estimated design temperatures. Replace with engineer-confirmed ASHRAE 2021 values, and correct the elevation to the site if the design is sensitive to air density.
